newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgargas curbs gas supplies to debtor companies.
newsitem.headline: Bulgargas curbs gas supplies to debtor companies.

text.p: Bulgarian state gas supplier Bulgargas said on Thursday it has started curbing Russian natural gas supplies to some of the biggest industrial plants who had not paid their bills.
A company statement said unless customers paid their bills, Bulgargas was unable to pay its foreign gas suppliers.
Bulgargas will completely cut gas supplies unless debtors do not pay within 24 hours.

Among the 63 plants, which have not paid their supplies in January, are the chemical plants Chimko in Vratsa and Neochim in Dimitrovgrad and the metalworks giant Kremikovtsi. Ninety six plants have not paid their supplies for February.
Bulgaria is in severe petrol and grain crisis due to a lack of funds to buy crude and wheat.
